title: 3 Days Yoga Retreat in Canggu, Bali
metaTitle: 3 Days Yoga Retreat in Canggu Bali
metaDescription: Create a new dimension this vacation as you combine a holiday experience with the ingredients of health and wellness through a 3 days yoga retreat in Canggu Bali.
summary: A 3 days / 2 nights yoga retreat in Canggu that you can start on any day of the week, following the weekly schedule of pranayama, Hatha, meditation, Yin, Yoga Nidra and sound baths.
intro: Our 3-day yoga retreat offers you the perfect escape from routine without requiring a lengthy commitment. Located in the vibrant beach paradise of Bali, where ancient temples blend with unlimited ocean horizons, this is a small but full-packaged program that offers the greatest impact in the shortest time possible.

What sets BYS apart is our flexible schedule program – you can choose your day of starting one of our many weekly programs and create your own unique experience, which suits your schedule. You can come on Monday and have a relaxing Hatha yoga and Om mantra meditation, or you can come on Thursday and have an invigorating Vinyasa flow with Shiva mantra practice; every combination will be a retreat of your own energy and intentions.
Ideal for busy professionals, interested beginners, or anyone who needs a meaningful reset without taking long breaks.

issues: Intro says 'Within 72 hours, you will be exposed to the entire gamut of yogic practices' — a 3 days / 2 nights stay with 12:00 pm check-in and check-out is ~48 hours; claim not used.
Intro uses 'revolutionary' and 'Transform Your Weekend into a Life-Changing Experience' — marketing language trimmed.
Private room fee is labelled 'Private Room Campus-I' (4–7 day Canggu pages say just 'Private Room').
Weekly schedule says 'Join for 3–7 days', but separate 8-, 9- and 11-day Canggu retreat pages exist (with a different, older format and pricing).
Sunday schedule lists lunch (1:00 pm) and dinner (7:00 pm) while the meal note says 'Lunch & Dinner are not served on Sundays'.
No massages are included in the Canggu 3–7 day retreats (unlike Ubud/Uluwatu); hub copy claiming daily Balinese massages in every retreat does not apply here.
Refund policy refers to a deposit but no deposit amount or booking process is stated on the page.
No airport/arrival directions on the page.
YouTube ID gkSEJujAw2A comes from the audit embed manifest (heading '✨ Transformative Yoga Retreat – Bali Yoga School'), not from visible text.
Map embed on this page (per audit manifest) points to 'Hotel Made Canggu 77' — verify the Canggu venue.
Accommodation text: 'All our accommodations are private rooms with A/C' — consistent with private-room-only pricing.
Price for 'Course with Meals (No Room)' is labelled '20% off' but 340 → 270 is not exactly 20% off (20% off would be 272; actual 20.6% off).
Price for 'Course with No Rooms, No Meals' is labelled '20% off' but 260 → 200 is not exactly 20% off (20% off would be 208; actual 23.1% off).
Teacher names (Yogini Chiara, Yogini Shanti, Yogi Pandu) are listed twice in the teachers block (duplicate carousel).
Founder section (Yogi Himanshu) contains unverifiable superlatives ('the most honest, hard-working, authentic person we can ever meet') — not extracted.
